change: Aura Club dashboard read projection and Jakarta routing

regionEvidence.note: Observed usage is time-specific. Configured CPU times maxInstances is not measured usage or cost. Reuse Jakarta; do not allocate a fourth region.

excludes: separately loaded redemption queue and member details
projection.scopedReads: Four stored shards per occupied branch scope; at most twenty authorized branches. Cross-branch redemptions require both branches and count once.
projection.writeCost: Relevant source writes use a transaction reading the current source, previous contribution and current student where applicable (2–3 documents), then write contribution and changed summary shards. Metadata-only changes are skipped.
projection.consistency: Eventual report updates through retryable Eventarc handlers; financial balances remain authoritative. Current-source transaction fences duplicate and out-of-order events.

client: Overview uses the Jakarta alias with one attempt per region and legacy read-only fallback.
Redemption queue requests pending/approved only and loads independently from overview.
Member and reward operations load when their panel is opened; exact student deep links open it automatically.
Account balances, earning policy and redemption writes are not result-cached.

validation.productionDependencyIndexes: READY and queries executed against the named database
validation.productionBusinessVerification: Read-only operator verification of projections and source totals; no impersonated user callable or test award.

rollout: Deploy and verify the five Jakarta projection workers, including source hashes and serving revisions.
Initialize projection records idempotently; compare every scope with the current source data before marking ready.
Deploy optimized canonical/alias readers and attendance no-op guard.
Verify actual serving revisions, unauthenticated rejection, Eventarc filters and error logs.
Release frontend only after the regional reader is healthy; verify exact deployed commit on both public domains.
